description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul greets the believers in Rome, longs to visit them, and declares that the gospel is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes. Humanity has turned from the Creator to idols, and God has given people over to what they desire.
1.sw: Paulo anawasalimu waamini walioko Roma, anatamani kuwatembelea, na kutangaza kwamba Injili ni nguvu ya Mungu ya kuokoa kila mtu anayeamini. Wanadamu wamemwacha Muumba na kugeukia sanamu, naye Mungu amewaachilia watu kufuata tamaa zao.
1.am: ጳውሎስ በሮም ላሉ አማኞች ሰላምታ ያቀርባል፤ ሊጎበኛቸውም ይናፍቃል፤ ወንጌል ለሚያምን ሁሉ የሚያድን የእግዚአብሔር ኃይል እንደ ሆነም ያውጃል። የሰው ልጆች ከፈጣሪ ዘወር ብለው ወደ ጣዖታት ሄደዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ለሚመኙት ነገር አሳልፎ ሰጥቷቸዋል።

2.en: God judges everyone without favor, Jews and Gentiles alike, by what they have done. Those who teach the law must keep it, and true circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit.
2.sw: Mungu anamhukumu kila mtu bila upendeleo, Wayahudi na watu wa mataifa vivyo hivyo, kulingana na matendo yao. Wale wanaofundisha sheria lazima waishike, na tohara ya kweli ni jambo la moyo, kwa Roho.
2.am: እግዚአብሔር አይሁድንም አሕዛብንም ሳያዳላ እያንዳንዱን እንደ ሥራው ይፈርዳል። ሕግን የሚያስተምሩ ሊጠብቁት ይገባል፤ እውነተኛው መገረዝም በመንፈስ የሚሆን የልብ ጉዳይ ነው።

3.en: God remains faithful even when people are not, and no one is righteous; all have sinned. Now God's righteousness has been shown apart from the law, through faith in Jesus, for all who believe, which leaves no room for boasting.
3.sw: Mungu anabaki mwaminifu hata wanadamu wasipokuwa waaminifu, na hakuna mwenye haki; wote wamefanya dhambi. Sasa haki ya Mungu imeonyeshwa bila sheria, kupitia imani katika Yesu, kwa ajili ya wote wanaoamini, na hivyo hakuna nafasi ya kujivuna.
3.am: ሰዎች ታማኞች ባይሆኑ እንኳ እግዚአብሔር ታማኝ ሆኖ ይኖራል፤ ጻድቅ የለም፤ ሁሉም ኃጢአት ሠርተዋል። አሁን ግን የእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ ያለ ሕግ፣ በኢየሱስ በማመን፣ ለሚያምኑ ሁሉ ተገልጧል፤ ስለዚህ ለትምክሕት ስፍራ የለም።

4.en: Abraham was counted righteous by faith before he was circumcised, so he is the father of all who believe. The promise comes through faith, and Abraham's story was written for us too, who believe in God who raised Jesus from the dead.
4.sw: Abrahamu alihesabiwa haki kwa imani kabla hajatahiriwa, kwa hiyo yeye ni baba wa wote wanaoamini. Ahadi inakuja kwa imani, na habari ya Abrahamu iliandikwa kwa ajili yetu pia, sisi tunaomwamini Mungu aliyemfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu.
4.am: አብርሃም ከመገረዙ በፊት በእምነት ጻድቅ ተብሎ ተቈጠረ፤ ስለዚህ ለሚያምኑ ሁሉ አባት ነው። የተስፋው ቃል የሚመጣው በእምነት ነው፤ የአብርሃምም ታሪክ ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ባስነሣው በእግዚአብሔር ለምናምን ለእኛም ደግሞ ተጽፏል።

5.en: Made righteous by faith, we have peace with God, and God's love is shown in that Jesus died for us while we were still sinners. As sin and death came into the world through one man, Adam, so grace and life come through one man, Jesus.
5.sw: Tukiwa tumehesabiwa haki kwa imani, tuna amani na Mungu, na upendo wa Mungu unaonekana katika jambo hili: Yesu alikufa kwa ajili yetu tulipokuwa bado wenye dhambi. Kama dhambi na kifo vilivyoingia ulimwenguni kupitia mtu mmoja, Adamu, vivyo hivyo neema na uzima vinakuja kupitia mtu mmoja, Yesu.
5.am: በእምነት ስለ ጸደቅን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ሰላም አለን፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ፍቅር ገና ኃጢአተኞች ሳለን ኢየሱስ ስለ እኛ በመሞቱ ይገለጣል። ኃጢአትና ሞት በአንድ ሰው፣ በአዳም፣ ወደ ዓለም እንደ ገቡ፣ እንዲሁ ጸጋና ሕይወት በአንድ ሰው፣ በኢየሱስ፣ ይመጣሉ።

6.en: Believers have died to sin with Jesus in baptism and been raised to live a new life for God. Once slaves of sin, they are now slaves of righteousness, for the wages of sin is death but God's gift is eternal life.
6.sw: Waamini wamekufa kwa dhambi pamoja na Yesu katika ubatizo na kufufuliwa ili waishi maisha mapya kwa ajili ya Mungu. Zamani walikuwa watumwa wa dhambi, sasa ni watumwa wa haki, kwa maana ujira wa dhambi ni kifo lakini zawadi ya Mungu ni uzima wa milele.
6.am: አማኞች በጥምቀት ከኢየሱስ ጋር ለኃጢአት ሞተዋል፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም አዲስ ሕይወት እንዲኖሩ ተነሥተዋል። ቀድሞ የኃጢአት ባሪያዎች የነበሩት አሁን የጽድቅ ባሪያዎች ናቸው፤ የኃጢአት ደመወዝ ሞት ነውና፤ የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ግን የዘላለም ሕይወት ነው።

7.en: Believers have been set free from the law as a widow is free to marry again. The law is holy, but sin uses it to bring death, and Paul describes the struggle of wanting the good and not doing it.
7.sw: Waamini wamewekwa huru kutoka kwa sheria kama mjane alivyo huru kuolewa tena. Sheria ni takatifu, lakini dhambi inaitumia kuleta kifo, naye Paulo anaeleza mapambano ya kutaka mema na kutoyatenda.
7.am: መበለት እንደ ገና ለማግባት ነጻ እንደ ሆነች ሁሉ አማኞችም ከሕግ ነጻ ወጥተዋል። ሕጉ ቅዱስ ነው፤ ኃጢአት ግን ሞትን ለማምጣት ይጠቀምበታል፤ ጳውሎስም መልካሙን እየፈለጉ አለማድረግን ትግል ይገልጻል።

8.en: There is no condemnation for those who belong to Jesus, for the Spirit of life has set them free. The Spirit makes them God's children, creation waits to be set free, the Spirit pleads for them, and nothing can separate them from the love of God.
8.sw: Hakuna hukumu ya adhabu kwa wale walio wa Yesu, kwa maana Roho wa uzima amewaweka huru. Roho anawafanya kuwa watoto wa Mungu, viumbe vinangoja kuwekwa huru, Roho anawaombea, na hakuna kitu kinachoweza kuwatenga na upendo wa Mungu.
8.am: የሕይወት መንፈስ ነጻ ስላወጣቸው የኢየሱስ ለሆኑት ኩነኔ የለባቸውም። መንፈስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ያደርጋቸዋል፤ ፍጥረት ነጻ የሚወጣበትን ይጠባበቃል፤ መንፈስ ስለ እነርሱ ይማልዳል፤ ከእግዚአብሔርም ፍቅር ሊለያቸው የሚችል ምንም ነገር የለም።

9.en: Paul grieves for Israel, his own people, and shows that God's word has not failed, for God chooses freely, as a potter shapes the clay. Israel pursued righteousness by works and stumbled over the stone God laid in Zion.
9.sw: Paulo anaomboleza kwa ajili ya Israeli, watu wake mwenyewe, na kuonyesha kwamba neno la Mungu halijashindwa, kwa maana Mungu anachagua kwa uhuru, kama mfinyanzi anavyoufinyanga udongo. Israeli waliitafuta haki kwa matendo, wakajikwaa juu ya jiwe ambalo Mungu aliliweka katika Sayuni.
9.am: ጳውሎስ ስለ ገዛ ሕዝቡ ስለ እስራኤል ያዝናል፤ ሸክላ ሠሪ ጭቃውን እንደሚቀርጽ እግዚአብሔር በነጻነት ስለሚመርጥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዳልወደቀ ያሳያል። እስራኤል ጽድቅን በሥራ ፈለገ፤ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ባኖረው ድንጋይም ተሰናከለ።

10.en: The righteousness that comes by faith is near: whoever confesses that Jesus is Lord and believes that God raised Jesus will be saved. Since people cannot call on one they have not heard of, messengers must be sent, though Israel heard and refused.
10.sw: Haki inayokuja kwa imani iko karibu: yeyote anayetangaza kwamba Yesu ni Bwana na kuamini kwamba Mungu alimfufua Yesu ataokolewa. Kwa kuwa watu hawawezi kumwita yule ambaye hawajamsikia, wajumbe lazima watumwe, ingawa Israeli walisikia na kukataa.
10.am: በእምነት የሚገኘው ጽድቅ ቅርብ ነው፤ ኢየሱስ ጌታ መሆኑን የሚመሰክርና እግዚአብሔር ኢየሱስን ከሙታን እንዳስነሣው የሚያምን ሁሉ ይድናል። ሰዎች ያልሰሙትን ሊጠሩ ስለማይችሉ መልእክተኞች መላክ አለባቸው፤ እስራኤል ግን ሰምቶ እምቢ አለ።

11.en: God has not rejected Israel; a remnant remains, and Israel's stumbling has brought salvation to the Gentiles. Paul pictures an olive tree with branches broken off and others grafted in, declares that all Israel will be saved, and ends in praise of God's wisdom.
11.sw: Mungu hajawakataa Israeli; mabaki yamebaki, na kujikwaa kwa Israeli kumeleta wokovu kwa watu wa mataifa. Paulo anaeleza mfano wa mzeituni ambao baadhi ya matawi yake yamevunjwa na mengine kupandikizwa, anatangaza kwamba Israeli wote wataokolewa, na kumalizia kwa kusifu hekima ya Mungu.
11.am: እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን አልጣለም፤ ቅሬታ አለ፤ የእስራኤልም መሰናከል ለአሕዛብ መዳንን አምጥቷል። ጳውሎስ ቅርንጫፎቹ ተሰብረው ሌሎች የተጣበቁበትን የወይራ ዛፍ በምሳሌ ያቀርባል፤ እስራኤል ሁሉ እንደሚድን ያውጃል፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ጥበብ በማመስገን ይደመድማል።

12.en: Paul urges the believers to offer themselves as a living sacrifice and to be transformed. They are one body with many gifts, and their love must be without pretense, overcoming evil with good.
12.sw: Paulo anawasihi waamini wajitoe wenyewe kama dhabihu hai na kubadilishwa. Wao ni mwili mmoja wenye karama nyingi, na upendo wao lazima uwe bila unafiki, wakiushinda ubaya kwa wema.
12.am: ጳውሎስ አማኞች ራሳቸውን ሕያው መሥዋዕት አድርገው እንዲያቀርቡና እንዲለወጡ ይማጸናቸዋል። ብዙ ስጦታዎች ያሉት አንድ አካል ናቸው፤ ፍቅራቸውም ያለ ግብዝነት፣ ክፉውን በመልካም የሚያሸንፍ መሆን አለበት።

13.en: Believers are to submit to the governing authorities and pay what they owe. Love fulfills the law, and since the day is near, they are to put on the Lord Jesus.
13.sw: Waamini wanapaswa kuzitii mamlaka zinazotawala na kulipa wanachodaiwa. Upendo unaitimiza sheria, na kwa kuwa siku iko karibu, wanapaswa kumvaa Bwana Yesu.
13.am: አማኞች ለሚገዙ ባለ ሥልጣናት መገዛትና ያለባቸውን መክፈል ይገባቸዋል። ፍቅር ሕግን ይፈጽማል፤ ቀኑም ስለ ቀረበ ጌታ ኢየሱስን መልበስ አለባቸው።

14.en: The strong and the weak in faith must not judge one another over food or special days, since all will stand before God. No one should make another believer stumble, for the kingdom of God is righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
14.sw: Wenye nguvu na walio dhaifu katika imani hawapaswi kuhukumiana kuhusu chakula au siku maalum, kwa kuwa wote watasimama mbele za Mungu. Hakuna anayepaswa kumkwaza mwamini mwingine, kwa maana ufalme wa Mungu ni haki, amani na furaha katika Roho Mtakatifu.
14.am: በእምነት ብርቱ የሆኑና ደካሞች ስለ ምግብ ወይም ስለ ልዩ ቀናት አንዱ ሌላውን ሊፈርድ አይገባም፤ ሁሉም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይቆማሉና። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ጽድቅ፣ ሰላምና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ የሚገኝ ደስታ ስለ ሆነች ማንም ሌላውን አማኝ ማሰናከል የለበትም።

15.en: The strong are to bear with the weak, as Jesus did, so that Jews and Gentiles together glorify God for mercy shown. Paul describes his work as a minister to the Gentiles, his plans to visit Rome on the way to Spain, and asks for prayer.
15.sw: Wenye nguvu wanapaswa kuwavumilia walio dhaifu, kama Yesu alivyofanya, ili Wayahudi na watu wa mataifa pamoja wamtukuze Mungu kwa rehema aliyoonyesha. Paulo anaeleza kazi yake kama mtumishi kwa watu wa mataifa, mipango yake ya kutembelea Roma akiwa njiani kwenda Uhispania, na kuomba waombewe.
15.am: ብርቱዎቹ ኢየሱስ እንዳደረገው የደካሞችን ድካም ሊሸከሙ ይገባቸዋል፤ ይህም አይሁድና አሕዛብ በአንድነት ስለ ተደረገላቸው ምሕረት እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያከብሩ ነው። ጳውሎስ ለአሕዛብ አገልጋይ ሆኖ የሚሠራውን ሥራ፣ ወደ እስጳንያ ሲሄድ ሮምን ለመጎብኘት ያለውን ዕቅድ ይገልጻል፤ እንዲጸልዩለትም ይለምናል።

16.en: Paul commends Phoebe and greets many believers in Rome by name. He warns against those who cause divisions, sends greetings from his companions, and closes with praise to God.
16.sw: Paulo anampendekeza Fibi na kuwasalimu kwa majina waamini wengi walioko Roma. Anaonya dhidi ya wale wanaosababisha mafarakano, anatuma salamu kutoka kwa wenzake, na kumalizia kwa kumsifu Mungu.
16.am: ጳውሎስ ፌቤንን አደራ ይላል፤ በሮም ያሉ ብዙ አማኞችንም በየስማቸው ሰላምታ ያቀርብላቸዋል። መለያየትን ስለሚያመጡ ሰዎች ያስጠነቅቃል፤ ከባልንጀሮቹ ሰላምታ ይልካል፤ እግዚአብሔርን በማመስገንም ይደመድማል።
